prompt:
Use case: character costume interpretation, non-canon human-form bonus art.
Asset type: transparent full-body anime visual novel sprite for Jorogumo / 絡新婦 from 《驚蟄》.
The two reference images show the official spider-monster version and establish long straight black hair, pale restrained menace, a controlled uncanny smile and visual identity. The user's EXPLICIT bonus exception is to draw her as a NORMAL HUMAN ADULT WOMAN, not the monster anatomy.
Draw her as a sinister school infirmary female doctor: a plain WHITE BUTTONED BLOUSE tucked into a fitted BLACK SHORT PENCIL SKIRT, BLACK HIGH HEELS, and a LONG WHITE LAB COAT worn open over the outfit. The skirt ends above the knee; the coat is much longer, around the calves, and has clean recognizable medical-coat lapels. Keep the outfit professional and coherent, with normal fabric folds and no exposed cleavage.
Adult human appearance, mature and composed, long black hair, pale natural human skin, two normal human eyes with a sharp gray-dark gaze, a small calculating smile. The eye interpretation belongs only to this non-canon human bonus design. No glowing or extra eyes, no spider limbs, no claws, no chitin, no machinery, no spider ornaments, no bridal hood, no kimono and no nurse cap. Exactly two human arms and two human legs.
Standing in a stable subtle three-quarter pose with torso, hips, knees, ankles and high-heeled shoes consistently oriented. One hand relaxed near a coat pocket, the other visible and natural, with five fingers. Sinister confidence expressed through the eyes and smile, not gore or exaggerated villain laughter. No syringe, weapon, patient or other character.
Polished Japanese anime visual novel illustration, clean detailed linework and controlled cel shading with soft highlights, consistent with the project's character sprites. Not photorealistic, not 3D. One full-body figure, complete head and shoe soles visible, comfortable margin, portrait approximately 1024x1536.
Genuinely transparent alpha background. No scenery, room, backdrop, glow, halo, floor shadow, text, labels or watermarks.
